reviews.text:
We had a very disappointing experience with BluePearl and Dr. Judith D. Seltzer and unfortunately would not recommend this practice based on the care, communication, and follow-up we received.

We brought our dog in for allergy test and ultimately spent approximately $900. From the beginning, we felt pressured into an extremely expensive visit. We did not realize allergy testing was not possible, and our dog did not seem to have an acute problem to us. However, we figured we would keep the visit. We were told she did have a skin infection and she should start medicine.

Our biggest concern arose after our dog developed diffuse bumps shortly after starting cefpodoxime prescribed following the visit. We contacted BluePearl because we were concerned about a possible medication reaction. Rather than feeling that our concern was taken seriously and carefully assessed, we felt it was largely dismissed.

Our interaction with veterinary technician Diane was particularly frustrating. We found her response to our concerns dismissive and disrespectful. Most concerning to me was that during the discussion about a possible medication reaction, I was not asked whether our dog was experiencing any breathing problems until the very end of the second conversation (we called twice!). With a potential allergic reaction, I found that extremely troubling.

I am a physician myself, and I completely understand that adverse medication reactions happen and that no doctor or veterinarian can predict every complication. I do not fault Dr. Seltzer simply because our dog may have reacted to a medication. My concern is how our concerns were handled afterward. When a patient reports a possible medication reaction, I would expect prompt attention to the relevant safety issues, clear guidance, and appropriate follow-up.

We also felt that the overall experience was surprisingly transactional. BluePearl is part of a large corporate veterinary organization. Corporate ownership itself does not mean that care is poor, but when specialty veterinary medicine comes with premium pricing, I think it is reasonable to expect a correspondingly high level of communication, responsiveness, and compassion. Simply put, we felt we were ripped off.

We stopped the medicine, and Lily was fine!! We never saw a problem, and feel they were just trying to make money.

We love our dog and were perfectly willing to spend money to get her excellent care. This isn’t a complaint that veterinary medicine is expensive. It’s about spending approximately $900, feeling pressured during the process, and then feeling dismissed when we raised a legitimate concern about a possible reaction to a medication.

This felt like a scam. It takes a lot for me to write a review about another health care provider, but this was an awful experience. I would advice future pet owners to exercise extreme caution here.
Love very nice people

I am extremely disappointed with my experience at BluePearl Emergency Pet Hospital and, unfortunately, would give zero stars if that were an option.

On Saturday at approximately 10:00 PM, I brought my cat in because he had been vomiting after every meal. I clearly explained his symptoms to the nurse and later to Dr. Vazul.

After he was assessed, I was presented with estimates ranging from approximately $1,600 to $1,900. When I reviewed the estimate, I was concerned by the number of individual charges and questioned whether everything being recommended was truly necessary.

One of my biggest concerns was sedation. I was told my cat would need to be sedated in order to complete some of the recommended testing, including X-rays. I specifically explained that he is not aggressive and has always been described by veterinary staff as an extremely calm and sweet cat. He has even undergone a procedure involving his ear without sedation and tolerated it well. Despite my concerns, I was told sedation was necessary for the safety of the staff.

I understand that veterinarians have to make decisions based on safety, and I am not a medical professional. However, after what happened afterward, I am left questioning whether sedation was actually necessary in his particular case.

Communication was another major issue. Dr. Vazul  repeatedly explained things using medical terminology that I did not understand. I specifically asked for the information to be explained to me in simpler terms because I am not a veterinarian or medical professional. I still left much of the conversation feeling confused rather than informed.

Ultimately, because my primary concern was finding out what was wrong with my cat, I agreed to the recommended testing. His bloodwork came back reassuring. X-rays were also performed, and I was additionally charged for a professional radiology interpretation. I was then told that something abnormal appeared on the X-rays, but they could not determine exactly what it was and recommended an ultrasound.

BluePearl was unable to perform the ultrasound at that location, so I was told I would need to take my cat to another emergency hospital.

At the second ER, I was told they could not confidently rely on the previous X-rays, so additional imaging/testing was performed. What stood out to me was that they were able to handle my cat and complete their testing WITHOUT sedating him. He was treated gently and appropriately, exactly as I had explained he could be.

The second hospital’s bill was approximately $860.

After all of this, no obstruction or serious condition requiring emergency intervention was found. My cat was ultimately sent home with sensitive-stomach food. He ate it, kept it down, and has been doing well.

Between both emergency hospitals, I spent approximately $2,500. Had I gone to the second ER first, based on what ultimately occurred, my expense would have been approximately $860.

I fully understand that emergency veterinary medicine is expensive and that doctors sometimes have to rule out serious conditions. My frustration is not simply that I had to pay for medical care. My frustration is with the overall experience: the communication, the recommendations I questioned, the sedation I was told was necessary despite my concerns, the additional radiology charge without receiving a definitive answer, and ultimately having to go elsewhere and essentially start the process again.

When someone brings a sick pet to an emergency hospital, they are already scared and vulnerable. They should feel that recommendations and costs are being clearly explained to them in language they understand and that every procedure being recommended is truly necessary for their individual pet.

Unfortunately, that is not how I felt during my experience at BluePearl. I left feeling overwhelmed, financially drained, and dissatisfied with the care and communication I received. Based on my experience, I would not return.
Your 5-star review means the world to us! Thank you!

Excellent.
Convivial, empathic staff, our pet is fine!
I am impressed
Serge Mosovich MD

Dr. Borchert was very knowledgeable, kind and compassionate to me and my cat at our visit. Aside from that, the experience overall was very disappointing in that the entire day they only had one vet on duty so there was an extremely long wait. Kind of crazy for a NYC animal hospital.  I waited nearly 8 hours for my cat to have an ultrasound and to get the results. I was later told by the front desk that the ultrasounds aren't usually performed until after 3pm--info that would have been useful to know when I called beforehand. Additionally the first person on duty at the front desk admitted she forgot to follow up and get the bloodwork results from my primary vet.  The second person on duty at the desk told me I would get a call when my cat was ready to be picked up after the ultrasound. I never received a call so I headed in and was told my cat was indeed finished with his exam, so I'm assuming the front desk forgot to call me. When I asked the person at the desk if they forgot to call me, she just kept repeating the vet would be up in a few minutes to talk to me (that few minutes was 40, btw). Not once did she acknowledge or apologize for the incompetence of the Blue Pearl front desk staff. These are our loved ones in life or death situations! Where is the urgency and compassion? I think the entire staff was overwhelmed and the hospital is very understaffed which resulted in extremely subpar service. Additionally the vet tech who did the intake of my cat took my cat away to be examined and just picked up the carrier and whisked him out of the room without any consideration that this is my beloved fur baby who I wanted to comfort with a few words first. The lack of empathy and compassion from him was very off-putting. (He was a young white guy with an accent and growing out hair pulled back in a headband.)  I've had much better experiences at VEG but came here as my primary vet practice works with BluePearl. Despite my negative review of the practice overall, Dr. Borchert was fantastic.

Do not bring your pet here .they don’t communicate time so you will be sitting for hours and they treat the dogs awfully.  my dog was in a kennel for hours without telling me I could have been sitting with her or brought  her home and they cut her stomach from shaving her fur and charged me an exorbent amount for NOTHING I should have seen the bad reviews and not wasted my time.

Not great. They're insanely expensive and kept me waiting for 2.5 hrs for a routine, scheduled appointment. I've used Blue Pearl in the past for surgeries and specialists, but they've gone downhill by a lot in the past 4 years, it's not even comparable. There was a mass exodus of so many of the good doctors from that time and the management seems to have gotten greedy and sloppy. It's really too bad, and I hate to say it but I think AMC is the best bet in NYC these days.

Disorganized, slow, bad at coordinating between staff. Every phone call they will make you restate information you have already given them.

Worst of all is that overnight they will completely disregard the treatment plan that was agreed on with them the night before. We had all agreed that overnight Blue Pearl would do a simple aspiration of fluid from our cat’s belly. Without even bothering to call us, they change the treatment plan and don’t do the procedure.  First, they tried to blame their unilateral change of mind on “oh the procedure was too risky”—even though our regular vet and vet cardiologist can do it in their office, and we had already agreed to the procedure and the risk. Then they said our cat recovered well enough that the procedure was not necessary. Well after our regular vet cardiologist did the aspiration a week later, our cat’s breathing IMMEDIATELY improved. Last but not least, Blue Pearl nickel and dimed us about refunding part of the deposit we had already paid for the fluid aspiration!

Go to VEG or another animal hospital instead if you want anyone to respect your choices or to actually read the notes from other staff.

AVOID THIS LOCATION LIKE THE PLAGUE IT IS A TOTAL RIP OFF!!! My personal experience has been that BluePearl massively overcharges relative to other alternative vet hospitals and vet care facilities.  It is owned by Mars whatever which owns vet hospitals across multiple states which in my personal view is focused on maximizing profit over vet care.  I am frankly shocked that any self respecting vet would work for Blue Pearl.  The best alternative downtown is the 24 hour vet hospital named VEG ER at corner of West 24th and 6th Avenue which offers better care for a fraction of the cost.

They are supposed to be an emergency hospital (ER) but the receptionist said the vet won’t be able to do an emergency ultra sound until the next day (20 hours later). They are treating this like a regular clinic.

The best combination of people to run an emergency vet efficiently, compassionately, and with so much care. I brought my sick kitty at 10:30pm and while I didn't leave until about 1:30am, I knew that my cat was getting the best care. Dr. Fuller is incredible. He said reassuring things to me like "you did great bringing him in" that gave me a little brightness in a scary situation. He explained my cat's diagnosis very clearly, told me what he was going to do and what further steps I could take with my own vet. The nurses were similarly empathetic and warm. The front desk was on top of it, while again still having that through line of empathy and care. It took a while, at no fault to them whatsoever, but I know my cat came home healthier than he left. Thank you so much
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a review! Your support means everything to us, and we’re grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet.
Your 5-star review means the world to us! We’re so grateful to be a part of your pet’s health journey.

They took such incredible and kind care of my fading neonatal foster kitten, with true compassion and expertise (he survived!). When I saw another pet parent struggling and offered to help cover their costs, the team wouldn't hear of it and took care of it themselves. I've never seen a place show that kind of heart. I can't recommend BluePearl enough and will always come back with my ER pet emergencies! I was truly more than 100% willing to help pay for the other parent's costs, and they fully covered it rather than let me step in.

Plus, every single doctor and nurse on staff came to speak with me in the waiting room about my fading kitten and had personally investigated my case. In this instance my foster baby's care was covered by the ASPCA, but the attention to detail, compassion, and generosity made me confident I'll never go anywhere else with my own pets either.

Just waited an hour and a half with an actively vomiting dog only to be told that they were handling another emergency and it would still be a while. I completely get the need to triage, but operating at zero flex capacity as a vet ER kind of defeats the purpose. It’s not a real walk in emergency facility. (They had also forgotten about us for a while, as the receptionist noted with some embarrassment). In summary, if your pet is in any condition short of complete collapse, this is not a good option.

The hospital took good care of our pet, but miscomunicated information, claimed they called and sent messages that they didn't send, claimed to be surprised that we were coming to pick him up at 5:30 even though we called in advance to let them know (and they said okay), and held our cat for nearly five more hours. They didn't release our cat until I called the police.

I recognize that emergency hospitals can be busy. But they also have to be responsive to caretakers who have a right to take their pets home. We had paid the bill, and we had been told in the morning that he was fine.They were only keeping him for observation. But we were repeatedly told that he wouldn't be released until his paperwork was completed. That is reasonable, but more than five hours to do paperwork is simply unacceptable. We called at 4:30, and the cat was not released until 11:00 PM.

This is the only time I've taken a pet to an emergency pet hospital, but I find it hard to believe that this is normal.

Blue Pearl Pet Hospital is the place to go if your furry friend is ill.  Everyone from the receptionist, Nurse, and doctor were so caring.  They were so good with the examination and explaining everything in detail from the cost to the diagnosis.  Very caring.  My pet was treated so well that the next day he was feeling better.  Definitely will return if needed.

Covered in AI generated informational posters (lazy) so you can get a $500 consult to get a surgery estimate 3x higher than a previous procedure my dog received for the same issue, with a staff that’s shrugging and throwing up their hands and saying “they’re really inflating the prices everywhere no to push pet insurance” and they’ve clearly resigned to that because they have no control or choice.

Let me save you $500 - it’s not worth the visit, and I would never trust my dog’s life with this place in a million years.

Did not have a great experience. Went in at 4 am because my dog was continually licking the floor and hacking for hours on end. They ran tests and diagnosed with kennel cough when he simply had something stuck in his throat. He continued to hack when we got home. I gave him some bread to see if he had something stuck, and he no longer coughed for the rest of the day. They falsely diagnosed and gave anti nausea meds when they were not needed.

Last year our dog received an ultrasound that came out slightly blurry. When she came out, we were told everything went great. When the results came back inconclusive because they couldn’t see anything, we called to complain about being charged $900 and asked that it’d be done again. We were denied and told that it would cost another $900. I’d recommend going to either VERG or ABC unless you have money to throw away on incompetence
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your trust in our care for your pet!

Dr. Munjal at Blue Pearl Downtown l, a clean,, calm facility. was kind in his treatment of our dog and us.   He calmly explained our options and the treatment was thorough.  Our dog left carefree and happy with the health issues resolved.

The front desk staff was great too!

This will be our Emergency Vet of choice from now on.
They tried to put my dog down when we went to another vet they said that was completely unnecessary.

If I could give less than 1 star, I absolutely would. Though the front desk staff has always been nice when I've gone, this review is directed at Dr. Kahn and the team's general inability to communicate properly.
My dog had a rapidly growing non cancerous mass that Dr. Kahn gave us 2 options for: removing most of it and leaving cells behind and needing to follow up with continuous radiology, or removing the entire mass that he insisted would lead to complications that would force us to put her down. They wanted approximately $13K for this procedure. We love our dog and were willing to front the bill, but Dr. Kahn gave me incorrect information regarding a referral to a radiologist and this delayed my dog's surgery, only allowing it to grow more. I attached a photo of the many days, almost a week straight, that I tried to get in contact with Dr. Kahn, but was blatantly disregarded and ultimately ignored when he never got back to me. It is absolutely unacceptable for a practice to have such negligent communication practices, especially for such a time sensitive case, and even more so when they are so expensive. A $400 consultation fee and no one could get back to me for a week? Deplorable and genuinely embarrassing.
When Dr. Kahn did eventually get back to me, he was aloof, dismissive, and essentially belittled my problem by saying the oncologist appointment "wasn't too far away anyway" (duh? an extra week had already passed? If I weren't desperate to get my dog treated I would have cursed him out right there. I doubt it would have been the first time it happened.)
Come to find out, when I try to book my dog's surgery, I was told Dr. Kahn wasn't there anymore and my dog would have to be operated on by someone else. Correct me if I'm wrong, but shouldn't Dr. Kahn's patients be notified beforehand? He had been (unfortunately) seeing my dog for weeks and no one had the decency to tell me he was no longer available to do her surgery until I called to schedule it? Please, make it make sense. I don't think BluePearl can.
Thank God I was able to find another vet, one I could trust with my dog, was extremely communicative, and removed the ENTIRE MASS for less than $3K. My dog is fine. She was not put down. I don't know what is wrong with Dr. Kahn, but it needs to be addressed immediately, if and when he comes back to the practice.
I will be in contact with everyone I can get ahold of to escalate this further.
Thank you for the 5 star rating.  We truly appreciate your support!

We had to unfortunately rush our dog to Bluepearl over the weekend for hemolytic anemia and Dr Jung and all the staff were so amazing. Dr Jung was quick to action/kept us super updated, kind, informative and patient with all our questions. She even followed up a couple times and made sure our dog was ok after she was discharged.

I came with my cat Rocky around 12 or 1 o’clock that morning a.m. NYC they are immediately took care of my cats so thank you and I’m glad you got an animal hospital emergency room. They gave me some good advice and they really helped me
We’re grateful for your review.
Your trust means so much to us! Thank you for your support!
All the staff, from the front desk to the vet tech and vet, were lovely. Felt that my cat was well looked after and the bill was not unreasonable.

I am incredibly grateful for Dr. Fuller, the nurses, and the entire staff for the compassion and care they showed my Belladonna. From the moment we arrived, I felt that Bella was being treated with genuine kindness and concern.

Dr. Fuller is truly amazing—an absolute angel. She was caring, empathetic, patient, and genuine. She took the time to listen to me, explain Bella’s condition, and make sure Bella received the care she needed. I never felt like Bella was simply another patient to her; I could genuinely feel that she cared about her wellbeing.

What touched me even more was the consideration shown toward my financial situation. I was already struggling with the cost of Bella’s treatment, and Dr. Fuller extended a kindness that significantly eased that burden and allowed Bella to receive the care and accurate medication she needed. She never made me feel embarrassed or judged for struggling financially. Instead, she met me with compassion and helped us during a moment when I truly needed it.

After such a stressful and emotional day worrying about Bella’s eye, Dr. Fuller felt like the miracle of our day. I walked in frightened and overwhelmed, but I left feeling supported and incredibly grateful that Bella had been placed in such caring hands.

Thank you, Dr. Fuller, the nurses, and every staff member who helped care for my little Belladonna. Your kindness toward both Bella and me meant more than you probably realize. I will never forget the compassion you showed us. ❤️🐾

I had a sick kitten and went to 3 Blue Pearl locations within 2 days. One in Forest Hills Queens, one in Midtown Manhattan, and one in Downtown Manhattan. All 3 locations were great. The staff were very nice, the offices were clean, and the vet was very helpful.
Thank you for the 5 star rating!
They are compassionate and accommodating
We’re so grateful you chose us! Thank you for the 5 star rating.
We’re thrilled to see your 5-star rating ! Your trust in our team is truly appreciated.

The visit was great. The front desk staff were caring and efficient, they even called my regular vet to get our dog's medical history. The nurse did a thorough intake then passed it off to the doctor who reviewed the medical history, conducted his exam, then sat with us explaining his findings and recommendations which where clear and helpful for our dog's situation.

My daughter and I took her cat Lola to see Dr Tony Kahn.  An absolutely wonderful experience.  Such a loving and caring Dr.  He literally laid on the floor to examine Lola carefully.  He acted like she was the only patient of the day.  The gentleman who assisted him was also wonderful.  I too have a cat and am grateful Blue Pearl is so close.

Our senior pup was vomiting long enough that around 9 pm, we realized we needed to have him seen. From the first call to our check-out, the staff was helpful, clear and kind. The vet described our treatment options clearly and we were able to understand what it would cost. We were there less than an hour. Hope not to need their services again, but won't hesitate if we do!
Dr. Katz, as well as the other staff members who were working on 7/12/26 were absolutely wonderful.

My family/I had to make the most difficult decision to transition🌈🪽🤍🧸🐾🙏 our beloved fur baby/princess LADY at Blue Pearl Pet Hospital on 06/05/26. The Blue Pearl staff made our visit meaningful comfortable and smooth. They were so compassionate informative and patient to us and loved on our princess prior to her procedure as well as following. We give huuuge shoutouts and much thanks to the desk receptionist KiKi for her warm heart professionalism hugs and comforting words. It truly meant sooo much in our time of need. We actually picked up our precious princess 1 wk following her transition to bring her home which gave us some closure. Blue Pearl and the Crematory prepared/presented us with a beautiful bag of our fur baby/princess inside her Urn 2 paw prints seeds to plant to memorialize her and other sentimental items. Completely heartfelt as we will furever cherish. Thank you Blue Pearl Pet Hospital for all your support and compassion❤️
Your 5-star review made our day! Thank you for trusting us with your pet’s care—we’re so grateful to have wonderful clients like you.

Dr. Fuller, Christen, Nurse & Michelle, Front Desk, Were all the best at what they did. Dr. Fuller an excellent professional as well as a skilled surgeon, Christen a postop nurse who covered it all and Michelle the lone individual who offered support and comfort as I waited to hear of my cherished pet. Thank you all for making an unexpected experience one of a positive memorable one that could not have been better!!
With much gratitude,
Kathleen, Eos Ros parent
Thank you for your review! Your support means so much to us, and we’re always here for you and your pet.
We’re grateful for your rating and for trusting us with your pet’s care. Your feedback helps us continue to grow and improve!
Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a review! Your support means everything to us, and we’re grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet.

The woman who checked me in was rude and seemed annoyed that I was there- my dog was having a medical emergency at 2am, I was understandably stressed and her nonchalance and annoyed attitude were awful. The vet tech was likewise seemed incredibly irritated, and had obviously been woken up by the 1st woman to come see my animal. She then tried to DRAG a clearly terrified dog down the hall until I insisted she simply carry her (all 10 pounds). The actual vet was very polite but when the vet tech brought her back I had to demand the information about where the shot was given, she tried to just hand her to me and walk away. Not to mention that it was CLEARLY obvious that they would not even let me see my clearly petrified animal until AFTER I paid the bill - the whole thing was an awful experience with awful people who simply do NOT care about animals. Will NEVER bring my dog back there in an emergency, they made a horrible situation worse with their behavior. Absolutely do not recommend this place in an emergency, hire some people that actually care about animals.
I love Dr Mak. She diagnosed my dog where other Vets could not. She also takes her time & listens to your concerns. She is a wonderful Vet!

I came in during a crisis for me and my two beautiful cats, Anastasia and Natasha. Alita and Kyle at the front desk were caring and compassionate. Dr. Mendoza  as well as his associate Genesis were absolutely phenomenal and attentive to my needs as well as my beautiful cats. I would 100% come back here in case of emergencies for both of my girls.
Fast appointment scheduling, no wait time, very helpful and specialized vets

Dr. Fuller and her staff were amazing to me when I came in with my 12 year Monty who wouldn’t eat. I believe their compassionate care really helped save his life.
It’s also a very beautiful well kept  office . I personally witnessed Michelle warmly welcome new patients and clean rooms between visits. I did not however care for the bedside manner of Dr. karapet. I was having a hard enough time without her making me feel like all my questions were an inconvenience. I waited more than 3 hours to have my pet triaged and another family walked in and were seen ahead of us. She told me that the other patients were “more emergent.” I don’t know how that’s possible when  I was given an end of life plan by Dr. Fuller.
Still. The compassionate care they gave us helped Monty survive long enough to get us home for a second opinion. (We were visiting from upstate) thankfully Monty seems to be doing much better today. He was severely dehydrated and not eating. The fluids they gave him along with an anti nausea medication helped restore his appetite some.

doctor was great.
excellent attention given to explaining care and process.
Excellent experience. Great doctors and staff. Thank you for taking care of my baby.
Your 5-star review means the world to us! We’re so grateful to be a part of your pet’s health journey.

The kindness and attentiveness given at Blue Pearl Downtown is amazing. Even late at night they’ve got an amazing disposition. You’re welcomed by the nightshift with a sense of calm and a sense of “we got you.” Can’t say enough about these professionals. I hope to never have to go to the Animal ER again but if I do, I know my animal and I will be properly taken care of.

My HCM kitty swallowed a metal twist-tie and I was directed to Blue Pearl emergency by my vets office. Dr Ho was exceptional in gathering information, keeping me informed, and giving me options that took my cats health and the circumstances in mind. He gave me all the information I needed and the room to make a decision for my kitty’s care, and was supportive in helping me with the decision I made. The whole staff I interacted with at Blue Pearl was professional and supportive.

We are grateful for your feedback and always strive to provide the best experience for both pets and their families. If you are open to it, please reach out to us to share more about what we could have done differently.
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your trust in our care for your pet!
It’s an honor to care for your pet! Our team is dedicated to providing the best possible care, and knowing we’ve earned your trust means everything. We truly appreciate your support!
Thank you for choosing us to care for your pet! It’s a privilege to be part of their journey, and we’re so grateful for your trust and positive review.
Good job. Thorough. Kind.
Great service, friendly staff. Doctor listened to our concerns, didn’t wish us, and offered helpful solutions.

Great dermatology team. Very kind vet, Dr Seltzer, who provides great detail and ensures clear understanding.

My only note is front desk seems like they need more staff, at times were overwhelmed

The front desk staff, Julia (nurse), and Dr. Schreffler were all great. There was a bit of a wait for Saturday evening (2-2.5 hours spent there total), but my animal was lower triage. Will go here again for emergency situations!
Your 5-star review means the world to us! We’re so grateful to be a part of your pet’s health journey.
Thank you for being there! The staff from entering your exit was incredible!
I went to the one in Downtown. Vet and assistants were so nice and attentive. I’ll go again if needed

I brought my dog Charlie in around 8pm after he’d been diagnosed with pneumonia earlier that day. He was having trouble breathing and was really weak, and I was really scared.
Dr. Taylor was amazing. She was calm, patient, and just really kind the whole time. She understood that cost mattered to me and walked me through everything without making me feel pressured. I appreciated that a lot, and the bill ended up being much more reasonable than I expected.
Charlie stayed overnight in the oxygen tank, and everyone I interacted with was super kind. The nurses were great, and Dr. Taylor even called to give me updates, which really helped and gave me a piece of mind. I really felt like they cared about charlie.

Our dog received fantastic care here for a sudden-onset, potentially fatal autoimmune disease that required 6 days of hospitalization. The staff at Blue Pearl (first the Chelsea location, then the Midtown location where we transferred for escalated care) were thorough and professional while still being warm and compassionate. They quickly ascertained a working diagnosis and clearly laid out a treatment plan, expectations, and contingencies, and they were clearly deeply invested in our dog's health and excited to see her improve. We have great confidence in following up with them for her continued care, and if we run into problems in the future, there's no question that we're going back.

Staff and doctors at Blue pearl pet hospital are so caring and compassionate. My pet Coco was admitted here overnight for breathing and heart problems, and Dr. Ho and team took great care of Coco.  Highly  recommend this hospital.

Very caring, knowledgeable staff and doctors took care of my 4 month old German shepherd who came in with severe lethargy , swollen back ankle and fever.  She had to spend the night but they properly brought her health back and gave her a lot of attention.  Grateful my pup is back to her self!

Excellent service, attention and expertise was given to our 4 month old German Shepherd Puppy. She came in with severe lethargy, fever, swollen back leg and limping.  With proper care, she came home the next day highly improved.  Communication and support was very professional and empathetic.  They even provided puppy food, pill assist treats to take home!
Great emergency services. Thank you!
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your trust in our care for your pet!
Dr. Mak is an amazing vet, she was so thorough, patient and knowledgeable!
Dr. OC was extremely thorough with tests and made sure everything was straight forward and transparent regarding the care of my cat.

I unfortunately was not pleased with the services I received. Aside from Dwayne at reception who was sympathetic and very kind. I was misquoted on the euthanasia said it was 600.00
.The veterinarian Dr. Fuller Had the bedside manner of a cold wet rag. She did it in a hurry and then picked up my baby like a sack of potatoes with her head flopping all over the place and That's what I take with me on the last day of having my baby alive.  She was 18.5 years old. What I would say is that there was no empathy coming from the vet. Toward the customers that they charge , my bill was over a thousand dollars  just for euthanasia. I was extremely disappointed on the top of being broken. So I wouldn't recommend  to anyone who loves their pet.

We will now be going here for all of our urgent pet needs. Everyone at BluePearl was incredibly kind, caring and supportive. A pet emergency is understandably a stressful experience, and we felt taken care of every step of the process. The front desk staff, nurse and night doctor listened to all of our concerns and acted promptly to provide the support our pet needed.

Throughout the entire process we felt like we had a clear sense of the situation, what the outlook was, and all the steps they were taking to ensure our pet was well taken care of. We had to hospitalize our pet overnight, and the doctor the next day provided us with a comprehensive update and stayed on the phone with us to answer all of our questions.

Before coming to BluePearl, we had tried a different Pet ER that was closer to us in Williamsburg, but after being disappointed in their service we went to BluePearl and are so happy that we did - we will always come back to BluePearl for any other needs.

We can’t thank the amazing staff at BluePearl enough for taking care of our little guy and ensuring he got the support and attention that he needed.
